source_context: Toki OH discovery: System reminder API and notification enablement requirements checked against primary OpenHarmony docs: https://github.com/openharmony/docs/blob/master/en/application-dev/reference/apis-backgroundtasks-kit/js-apis-reminderAgentManager.md. Source cancels old ID before publication, ignores overdue requests while returning true, catches map read/write failures, and returns permission-request success even when denied. Native returned IDs are mapped; process setInterval does not establish process-exit survival. Shared Dart documentation mentions Android foreground-service semantics and extra schedule arguments that this OH implementation does not use. Consumer truthful expired/denied outcomes, serialized replace, compensation and restart reconciliation are safeguards beyond the observed source. Acceptance criteria were not executed. No application-level license identified in pinned tracked files or README; third_party/vyuh_node_flow/LICENSE applies to the vendored component, not the entire app. No application implementation copied into consumer guidance. Validation tier: pinned source/diff and primary-document inspection only.
